flags.cycle_note: QEMU 8.2 does not model the Cortex-M3 DWT (DEMCR/DWT_CTRL read 0); the C harness probes DWT first and falls back to the SysTick 24-bit down-counter, which under -icount shift=0 ticks every 40 instructions (25 MHz tick clock, 1 ns per instruction). cycles_src= in RESULT says which source was used. The Zig image calls the same unmodified firmware/common/cycles.c module.
flags.fairness_note: firmware/common/{startup_armv7m.S,semihost.c,cycles.c,stack.c} and firmware/common/mps2_an385.ld are compiled UNMODIFIED into both the C and the Zig image, so the harness overhead (vectors, semihosting, cycle counter, stack painting, linker script) is byte-identical on both sides. The only deliberately different runtime piece is the compiler support library: the C build links -nostdlib + firmware/c/libc_stubs.c, the Zig build links Zig compiler_rt, which supplies the same EABI mem*/64-bit helper surface (firmware/README.md portability note 3). Only the workload + database code is Zig (src/flashdb.zig, firmware/zig/fw.zig).
